name: twrses-worldhist
description: 世界歷史 World History 的共用引擎（timeline.js 平行時間軸的純函式、timeline2d.js 時間軸、sphere.js 球面幾何、land.js 陸地資料、hglobe.js 歷史地球儀、map2d.js 畫在 canvas 上的世界地圖）與各課的原始碼。產物寫到 assets/js/wh-*.js，npm run build 重新打包。

scripts.build: esbuild src/wh-spread.js src/wh-farm.js src/wh-tablet.js src/wh-pyramid.js src/wh-assembly.js src/wh-arch.js src/wh-coins.js src/wh-dharma.js src/wh-silk.js src/wh-faith.js src/wh-books.js src/wh-castle.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --legal-comments=eof --outdir=../../assets/js
scripts.test: node test/timeline.test.mjs && node test/sphere.test.mjs && node test/land.test.mjs && node test/spread.test.mjs && node test/farm.test.mjs && node test/farming.test.mjs && node test/tablet.test.mjs && node test/writing.test.mjs && node test/pyramid.test.mjs && node test/rivers.test.mjs && node test/assembly.test.mjs && node test/greeks.test.mjs && node test/arch.test.mjs && node test/rome.test.mjs && node test/coins.test.mjs && node test/qinhan.test.mjs && node test/dharma.test.mjs && node test/buddhism.test.mjs && node test/silk.test.mjs && node test/silkroad.test.mjs && node test/faith.test.mjs && node test/faiths.test.mjs && node test/books.test.mjs && node test/knowledge.test.mjs && node test/castle.test.mjs && node test/castlelife.test.mjs && node test/goldsalt.test.mjs && node test/mayanum.test.mjs && node test/americas.test.mjs && node test/zhenghe.test.mjs
